profileEvidence.summary: Playful curiosity and close companionship can go together in Lhasaliers. This Cavalier King Charles Spaniel–Lhasa Apso cross can be quick to learn and occasionally mischievous. Some enjoy water and snow, then settle for a cuddle under a blanket. Energy and habits vary between individuals, and quiet lap time can accompany lively exploring.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Lhasaliers can be curious, playful companions who enjoy learning, exploring and settling close for a quiet lap cuddle.
